thread:
Priya M.: Heads-up — Renewal convo with Astra Labs. They've asked to shorten the 12mo commitment to 9mo and apply the remaining 3mo as a credit on the account instead of a refund. Procurement says they'll only sign a PO if the contract term equals the billed period. Need input on whether we can accept term change + keep PO value intact.

Leo G.: Are they asking to keep the total spend the same but shift the services window? or to reduce billed amount and keep PO full? clarity matters for revenue recognition.

Priya M.: They want total cash paid now to be equal to a 9mo charge. They'd like us to accept their existing PO (covers 12mo) and issue a credit voucher for the 3mo difference to be used against future services. Procurement asked for vendor code alignment across billing entities — their finance team uses a separate vendor code for SaaS vs. services and wants PO split.

Nina K.: From CS side, okay with 9mo active term in the portal, but legal needs an amendment stating: 9mo term, credit voucher issued for unused months, voucher redeemable within 12 months, no refunds. Also need delegated signature confirmation if signer differs from PO signer.

Sam F.: Finance input: We can accept PO for full value (matching client constraint) and post a credit note or voucher. But vouchers have accounting implications; prefer credit memos referencing invoice IDs. If they insist on vouchers, we need to record a deferred liability and track expiration. Also vendor code split is non-trivial — our billing system expects one vendor code per invoice. Splitting PO across vendor codes will require manual journal entries.

legal-bot: Automated check: Proposed amendment must include non-refund clause, voucher expiry, and reconciliation procedure. Missing: delegated signer proof field. See legal checklist: https://legal.redwood.ai/amendment-checklist.

Priya M.: Customer prefers voucher method for internal budgeting — they can't accept a credit memo retrospectively for accounting reasons. They ask if we can issue a voucher code redeemable in 12 months.

Leo G.: Can we do a hybrid: issue the invoice for 12mo to match PO, then burn a voucher equal to 3mo value that shows on their account balance and can be applied to future invoices. Finance?

Sam F.: Hybrid doable but needs explicit entry: Invoice full amount, then generate a promotional credit (voucher) referencing the invoice and PO. Finance will book the voucher as a liability with an expiration. We'll need the PO number and a delegation email before issuing. Also, vendor code mismatch will remain a manual reconciliation item — add a comment in the invoice: "Vendor code: SaaS - VC-300A; Services - VC-300B (split per customer request)." That should help their AP team.

Priya M.: OK — customer can provide PO today and will email delegated signer. They also asked for e-sign through a third-party (Coupa Sign) rather than DocuSign. Any blockers?

Nina K.: Legal prefers DocuSign for audit trail but can accept Coupa Sign if customer uploads a certified copy and signature metadata (IP, timestamp). We'll require the certified PDF and signer email chain as proof of delegation. Add clause: "Third-party signing accepted if certification of signature and delegation email provided."

Sam F.: Finance-bot: PO required to proceed. Please upload PO to Billing portal: https://billing.redwood.ai/po-upload :warning:

finance-bot: Reminder: if vendor code differs from PO to invoice, attach vendor code approval note. Manual reconciliation will be flagged on the invoice.

Priya M.: PO uploaded: ASTRA-2025-334. Sending delegation email now (from CFO). Also requested voucher code be usable across subscriptions for 12 months.

legal-bot: Received delegation email. Certified signer documentation required for Coupa Sign execution. Reply with attach when available.

Sam F.: Creating invoice INV-20250305-4421 for full 12mo. Will create voucher VCHR-20250305-ASTRA for 3mo equivalent once we have certified Coupa Sign PDF and delegation proof. Note: voucher will be recorded as liable and expire 2026-03-05. Manual vendor-code note added. Expect voucher issuance by 2025-03-07 after docs clear.

Leo G.: Thanks — I'll update the renewal plan and customer onboarding timeline to reflect 9mo active term and voucher handling. Priya, let's confirm seat counts week of 03/10 to finalize voucher amount.

Priya M.: Will do. Closing loop for now — re-open if Coupa docs don't arrive. :white_check_mark:
